egress.terms: not published on the pages read: no egress term was found, so nothing is asserted

record.interface_detail: no console, API or CLI is documented on the pages read; ordering is a form and a sales contact
record.tooling: not stated: the pages read document no client; orders go through an order form and a solutions architect
record.chaining: An 8-GPU B300 or MI325X node is the smallest unit; the per-GPU-hour rate is published as a range. It does not offer single-GPU or older-generation cards on the pages read, so it does not serve a small job.

limits.value: orders go through an order form and a solutions architect; the node is 8 GPUs, B300 on-demand is a range of USD 6.50 to 8.50 per GPU-hour, and no H100, A100, L40S, RTX 4090 or L4 rate is published
